text:
maria (AE): Scout AI asked for a perf POC next week — target 1k steady QPS, microbursts to 3k for ~30s, p95 <200ms. They want a load plan, runbook, pricing estimate, and the security questionnaire answered. Compliance specifically asked about KMS/HSM + audit logs. Can we scope?

oliver (SE): Ack. Which model variant and avg prompt/response lengths?

maria (AE): Conversational assistant style. avg prompt ~120 tokens, response ~150 tokens. They prefer redwood-7b (int8) but will consider other variants if cheaper.

kevin (eng): For that mix we need KV cache warmup. Suggest a 10m ramp to 1k, run steady for 30–60m, and schedule 3–4 microbursts (30s @3k) spaced every 10–15m to simulate peaks. Queue sizing: concurrency ~= QPS * latency. For 200ms p95 => 1k * 0.2 = 200; add headroom => target concurrency 350–450. Autoscale policy should target <250ms tail.

kevin (eng): Example wrk commands to mimic traffic: 
```bash
# steady 1k qps for 10m
wrk -t8 -c400 -d10m -R1000 --latency -s scripts/llm_post.lua
# microburst 30s @ 3k qps
wrk -t8 -c1200 -d30s -R3000 --latency -s scripts/llm_post.lua
```

oliver (SE): Test config notes: batch_size=32, kv_cache=enabled, quantization=int8 (q8 path). We'll pin to `redwood-7b-q8` for the baseline. Sample request payload: 
```json
{"model":"redwood-7b-q8","input_tokens":120,"max_tokens":160,"temperature":0.0}
```

li (sre): We'll add per-request tracing + p50/p95/p99 dashboards. Need to know region (prefer us-west-2) and whether they want multi-AZ failover during the run. Important: if they require HSM for keys, that requires Private deployment — hosted/Dedicated can do customer-managed KMS but not HSM.

nina (sec): Security checklist reminders: encryption at rest: yes (AES-256). KMS integration: yes (customer-managed keys ok). HSM: only available for Private. Audit logs: available, will provide approvable sample. Need confirmation on data-retention and deletion SLA from customer. We should fill and send the security questionnaire before the run.

maria (AE): Pricing ask: rough hosted cost for steady 1k + bursts, and the ballpark for Dedicated reserved (monthly) for this workload. Also they want a burst allowance in any hosted quote.

oliver (SE): Quick compute: ~270 tokens/request -> 270k tokens/sec at 1k qps -> big token burn. I'll put a conservative per-hour burn in the doc rather than per-token guess — less confusing. For Dedicated, think ~6–10 A100-equivalent GPUs depending on concurrency and model optimizations; I'll give a monthly reserved range.

oliver (SE): I'll prepare a short pricing note and a simple cost model (steady + bursts + concurrency headroom) and attach it to the runbook.

perf-bot: scheduled job created: scoutai_poc/1747500000/run1 @ 2024-11-15T18:00Z

maria (AE): Proposed run window: Wed 18:00 UTC, 2 hours. @kevin (eng) @oliver (SE) can you own smoke + steady run? @nina (sec) can you prepare sec Q answers by EOD tomorrow?

kevin (eng): I'll own smoke + warmup. I'll create the wrk scripts and a small `scripts/llm_post.lua` that posts realistic JSON payloads and records latencies. Will add Grafana link once dashboard is up.

oliver (SE): I'll draft the runbook (attack plan, failure modes, rollback), pricing note, and a CSV template for results. Will include guidance on burst triggers and fallback to cheaper model variants if tail spikes.

nina (sec): I'll draft KMS/HSM note, SOC2 snapshot, and a redacted audit-log example. Legal needs to sign off if the customer insists on HSM.

maria (AE): Perfect. I'll brief Scout AI and propose Wed. If they accept, we'll lock the run and I'll share the customer contact and their questionnaire. Thanks all :thumbsup:

kevin (eng): One more: during bursts we should monitor GPU util + model stalls; add a short script to detect >80% GPU and trigger fallback to smaller model automatically. I'll add that to runbook.

oliver (SE): Noted. I'll add an ops play: `fallback_policy: model_chain = [redwood-7b-q8, redwood-3b-q4, redwood-1.3b-q4]`

maria (AE): Great — closing loop. I'll update thread with customer confirmation.
